analysis.reasonEn: Previous 3 consecutive buy signals maintained. RSI has exited oversold and settled in neutral territory, with MACD histogram showing continuous improvement. Current price of 113,890 KRW is approaching the swing resistance at 114,260 KRW, but with a 52-week position of 63.5%, there is room for further upside. Setting stop loss at 1.3x ATR (4,145 KRW) allows for support at 110,485 KRW.
